company- kinds of a company including one-person company, small

director; director identity number (DIN) - who can appoint a director,

director- interested directors- managing directors

conduct of meetings, requisites of a valid meeting; postal
ballot, meeting through video conferencing, e-voting; —Statutory, Annual
general meeting and Extra-ordinary General meeting.

conducting a Board meeting.
